document: DBC 2021 Part K.9.1 (electrical design), with DEWA Regulations for Electrical Installations 2017

rules.title: Distribution board location
rules.requirement: DBs not installed in bathrooms or toilets, damp or wet locations, bedrooms, kitchens, above sinks, store rooms, hot or hazardous rooms, or below a staircase.

rules.title: DB mounting height and access
rules.requirement: DB top <= 2 m above FFL; access available at all times.

rules.title: Socket outlets
rules.requirement: 13 A BS 1363 shuttered, switched socket outlets; 15 A to BS 546; IP55 outdoors; shaver outlets to BS EN 61558 in bathrooms.

rules.title: Accessory mounting heights
rules.requirement: Switches, AC / water heater DP switches and shaver outlets 1.25 m above FFL; general 13 A sockets 450 mm; kitchen sockets 150 mm above the worktop.

rules.title: Kitchen socket positions
rules.requirement: No socket within 300 mm of the sink edge; no sockets or accessories above gas or electric hobs.

rules.title: Sockets per circuit
rules.requirement: Radial final circuit: at most five 13 A sockets on a 20 A breaker; ring circuit: at most ten sockets on a 30 A breaker (rooms other than kitchen).

rules.title: Cooker control unit
rules.requirement: Cooker control switch (BS 4177) separate from the appliance and within 2 m of it, on its own final circuit through a 100 mA ELCB.

rules.title: Water heater and washing machine control
rules.requirement: Own final circuit, DP switch with neon and flex outlet; a water heater in a bathroom or WC has its switch immediately outside the room; heater circuits on 30 mA RCCB/ELCB.

rules.title: Air-conditioning unit circuits
rules.requirement: Each room AC unit on its own final circuit with an adjacent DP switch and flex outlet; minimum 20 A breaker and 4 mm2 wiring.

rules.title: Earth leakage ratings
rules.requirement: RCD/ELCB: 13 A sockets, water heaters, dishwashers, fridges, washers, domestic pumps 30 mA; window/split AC, FCU/AHU and cookers 100 mA; general lighting 30/100 mA.

rules.title: Lighting circuit loading
rules.requirement: Lighting and fan circuits <= 2,000 W, 2.5 mm2 LSF copper, <= 16 A breaker; 100 W per point if fittings are not selected.
rules.note: Load calculations are planned for a later version.
